name: SAE post adapter for 3/8-16 stud (negative)

mounts.note: origin = stud axis at the polarity ring top; threads onto the battery 3/8-16 stud (internal thread)

accepts.note: tapered SAE post; a clamp sits on the base top

source: Founder spec 2026-11-12: + post ~17.5 mm, - ~15.9 mm top diameter, ~19 mm tall over a hex base, 3/4 to 1 in added. Hex AF 0.75 in, base 0.20 in, 1 mm taper are estimates.
